DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Exacerbation of Asthma with Hypoxemic Respiratory Failure.

The combination of wheezing, exertional dyspnea, night-time symptoms, bronchial wall thickening on X-ray, and a PaO2 of 52 mmHg is highly indicative of severe asthma causing respiratory failure. Please ensure immediate oxygen support and administer nebulized bronchodilators.
